0000.png.text: What if Devin got a little better every week, by studying its own sessions? That's the idea behind a self-improving Devin.

chunks.text: What if Devin got a little better every
week, by studying its own sessions?

0001.png.text: Here's the loop. A schedule runs once a week. Devin finds the sessions that cost the most, works out what made them slow, and opens a pull request that adds or updates a skill. Next week's sessions start with that skill, and the loop runs again.

0002.png.text: Start with the costliest sessions, because that's where the lessons are. Session insights shows the detected issues, a timeline of where time went, and actionable feedback.
